entities.name: Iris, the Oracle of Ephara
entities.description: A blind seer from Meletis on Theros who flees toward freedom after Alexio's sacrifice.

entities.name: Alexio
entities.description: Skyguard escorting Iris, who falls in love with her and is left to die.

entities.name: Purphoros
entities.description: God whose agents tried to kidnap Iris.

entities.name: Soli
entities.description: Garrison Iris was to be taken to.

entities.name: Oracle's Insight
entities.description: Iris's prophetic vision triggered by touch.

events.summary: Perisophia tells Iris she will be escorted in secret to Soli because Purphoros's agents plan to kidnap her.
events.quote: agents of Purphoros had been sent to kidnap her

events.summary: Touching Alexio gives Iris a vision that he will love her and die.
events.quote: He would fall in love with her, and then he would be taken from her.

events.summary: Alexio kills two Purphoran men posing as highwaymen.
events.quote: Then Iris heard Alexio kill two men.

events.summary: Iris and Alexio fly on a pegasus and shelter in a cave, where Iris realizes she has fallen in love.
events.quote: Iris realized that she had fallen in love with him

events.summary: Enemies attack at the cave; wounded Alexio sends Iris away on the pegasus and stays behind to die.
events.quote: He put her on the pegasus and bid her fly as fast as she could.

events.summary: Iris turns the pegasus westward into the unknown rather than returning to her old life.
events.quote: not toward the garrison at Soli or Meletis, but westward into the unknown
